file: Your AI Agent for Compensation _ Openroll.htm

page-structure.evidence: Title 'Your AI Agent for Compensation | Openroll' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). Heading order is severely broken: two visible H1s on the active slide, then one H2 ('Ready to unlock operational excellence?'), then H6 for four footer sections ('Publisher', 'Navigation', 'Contact', 'Social Media') — skipping H3, H4, H5 entirely (1.3.1 / heading-order). No <main> landmark present (1.3.1 navigability failure). Three <header> elements all with banner role and no unique labels (axe landmark-no-duplicate-banner, landmark-unique). Nav landmark present. Six additional H1s in aria-hidden carousel slides (not visible to AT).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: Two <ul> elements with list-style:none and no role='list' attribute detected (listStyleNone:2). These lists lose list semantics in Safari+VoiceOver (WebKit-specific, 1.3.1). Tab and SR walking order follows DOM order and matches visual top-to-bottom sequence — no reading-order divergence for the active content. No modal or overlay detected.

issues.evidence: No <main> landmark. Three unlabelled duplicate <header>/banner landmarks. H2-to-H6 heading level skip (H1→H1→H2→H6) in footer — levels 3–5 absent.
Two <ul> elements with list-style:none and no role='list' — lose list semantics in Safari+VoiceOver.
Email link axName='support@openroll.' — truncated name does not convey full address; actual mailto href is 'support@compensara.io' (different domain).
Carousel 'Scroll to page 1' button — activation triggers slide change with no live region announcement (liveRegionChanged:false, vsrAnnouncement:null, liveRegions:[] in page).
Logo span: role=link, axName=null. Child img has alt=''. No aria-label. Unnamed interactive element fails 4.1.2 and 1.1.1.
Carousel 'Scroll to page 2' button — same announcement failure as page 1 button.
Button 20x30px — width 20px < 24px minimum touch target size. Axe target-size violation confirmed.
Off-screen 'Book demo' link in carousel slide 1 (box x=-867) receives keyboard focus but is not in viewport. tabWalk inViewport:false. Fails 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum, WCAG 2.2).
Login div: plain <div> with text 'Login', no role, no tabindex, no href. Invisible to keyboard and AT. srWalk reachedBySR:false.
Login div: tabIndex=-1, no focusable ancestor, no keyboard event handlers. Not in tabWalk stops. Keyboard-inaccessible despite appearing as a nav item.
'Marshall Studio' text: color rgb(94,94,94) on bg rgb(212,212,212). Contrast ratio 4.37:1 at 14px/500 weight (normal text, threshold 4.5:1). Fails 1.4.3. Axe color-contrast confirmed.
